title: Account linking flow for review: LinkAccount for unlinked users, editors only
description: Unlinked + review request: `linkAccountResponse` (Echo Show shows Amazon's QR), with speech that says what linking is for. Linked but not editor/admin: say review is for editors and offer the stories. Run Ryan's end-to-end check on the device, which closes the old spike PPY-ce567f. Gherkin covers it.
